flags: DROP CANDIDATE (mostly long-stay and iffy, reviewer decides): Google review (6 years ago) 'only 10 spots available for short-term stays. The rest are reserved for "long-term"' (about 10 of ~70 sites, ~14%, inside the 10-50% caveat band); the operator page offered 'Monthly Rates Available' and 'Management reserves the right to ... decide the length of stay of any camper'; imagery shows RVs on most pads. Iffy signs: the operator website stopped answering after 2026-10-16 (matarawarvpark.com now 301-redirects to the Viejas casino home page, which has no RV page; a review from a month ago says 'Need to update there website'), Google exactly 4.0 from 174 reviews with 'Pricy Dirty restroom' in the summary, and the amenities shrinking ('They no longer have a store and jaccui'). Long-stay tests: (1) nightly sold - yes; (2) posted nightly rate - only on the now-dead page ($35, read 2026-10-16); (3) no seasonal-only wording; (4) ~14% nightly by one 2020 camper report, unmeasured since; (5) no lot sales. Gate facts: $35 FHU (under $50), no gateway within 40 km, no Good Sam data. If kept, the proposed note carries the 'Mostly long-stay' caveat.
